name: Kurata Chiaki
source: Deputy leader of the Lakers. She is a girl who is feared as a delinquent at school. However, although she has a foul mouth, she is surprisingly caring. As her transformation name suggests, she specializes in kung fu and is adept at striking combat. Her family runs a Chinese restaurant, so she helps with the family business when she has nothing to do. She started to have a liking for Akira Daidōji during I.
